description: Google (official Vertex AI / Gemini API) — gemini-2.5-flash carries the high-traffic default tier (fast, multimodal), gemini-3-pro-preview codes, gemini-2.5-pro judges on the low-frequency advisor slot, gemini-flash-lite-latest explores. All Gemini models accept images — vision uses gemini-2.5-flash. Requires GOOGLE_GENERATIVE_AI_API_KEY environment variable.
